Name: Somni's Tractor Mod Recolor - Bog Style
Author: somnifey
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FETyULb.png[/img]

Somni’s Tractor Mod Recolor – Bog Style is a full visual overhaul of the Tractor Mod, created for Stardew Valley’s 10-Year ModFest using BogWyytch’s assets and palette. This recolor gives the tractor and garage a wtichy, bog-inspired aesthetic designed to blend beautifully with swampy farm builds. The garage features full seasonal variants. Both the tractor and UI icons have been recolored as well. This is a visual-only recolor. No gameplay changes have been made.

[code]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/pLQuz4T.png[/img]
[/code]
[b]NEW FOR V2[/b]: 4 Themed Color Collections - view images for examples
[list]
[*]Mossgrove: Dark wood with deep green accents
[*]Duskmire: Light wood with royal purple accents
[*]Deepwater: Dark stone with ocean blue accents
[*]Bloodpeat: Dark brick with rusty red accents
[/list]Continued from V1:[list]
[*]Seasonal garage (Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter)
[*]Recolored tractor sprite
[*]Updated inventory icon
[*]Recolored active buff icon
[*]Bog-inspired palette for cohesive aesthetic builds
[/list]
[code]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ggD1ojQ.png[/img]
[/code]Just like the original Tractor Mod:

Purchase the tractor garage from Robin at the Carpenter’s Shop. Once built, the tractor functions exactly as intended.

[code]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ySnSpQ.png[/img][/code]
